en.title: How the 787 shaped the Boeing 747-8: engines, wing and cabin borrowed from the Dreamliner
en.summary: Launched in November 2005, the 747-8 was pitched as a stretched, re-winged and re-engined 747-400 borrowing Dreamliner technology: GEnx engines, raked wingtips, fly-by-wire controls and a Dreamliner-style cabin — while keeping an aluminium airframe and a 747-400-like flight deck. The last of 155 aircraft left the line in early 2023.
body: When Boeing launched the 747-8 in November 2005, it presented the airplane as a stretched, re-winged and re-engined update of the 747-400 that would use technology borrowed from the 787 Dreamliner. The Dreamliner program had been launched only a year earlier, and its work on lightweight composites, efficient engines and electronically managed systems gave Boeing a supply of proven solutions at the moment the ageing jumbo needed them. Rather than commissioning an all-new quadjet for a limited market, Boeing chose to graft selected Dreamliner innovations onto a familiar airframe, which kept development costs manageable and preserved the operating familiarity that long-time 747 customers valued.

The most substantial transfer from the 787 program came through the powerplants. The 747-8 uses four General Electric GEnx-2B67 engines, a smaller-diameter relative of the GEnx developed for the Dreamliner, each generating 66,500 pounds (30,164 kg) of thrust with a 105-inch (267 cm) composite fan. Engineers modified the design so that each engine could supply bleed air, because the 747 still depends on a conventional pneumatic architecture that the 787 largely abandoned in favour of electrical power. Sawtooth-shaped chevrons line the rear of the engine housing, borrowing a noise-reduction device from the 787. The comparison table puts the 787's GEnx-1B at 184.7 inches long with a 111.1-inch fan and 76,100 lbs of maximum takeoff thrust, against 169.7 inches, 104.7 inches and 66,500 lbs for the GEnx-2B; the 1B has four compressor stages and seven low-pressure turbine stages, the 2B one fewer in each. The wing was redesigned with fresh airfoils and raked wingtips, the same approach used on the 777 and the 787, extending the span to roughly 224 feet (68.27 meters) against about 211 feet (64.31 meters) on the 747-400 to support a higher maximum takeoff weight. Boeing attributes the 747-8's higher cruising speed relative to the 747-400 to the combined effect of the wing, wingtips and engines.

The flight controls and cabin borrowed from the 787 with restraint. The 747-8 adopted elements of the 787's fly-by-wire philosophy, yet the flight deck keeps a layout and control feel close to its predecessor's so that qualified 747-400 pilots can move to the new model easily. The passenger version received an interior inspired by the Dreamliner's: curved, upswept ceiling panels, LED lighting running the length of the cabin, larger windows, and a wide, curved staircase replacing the classic narrow spiral one. The interior upgrades arrived alongside an 18-foot-4-inch (5.5 meter) fuselage stretch, letting Boeing quote a typical three-class capacity of 467 passengers. Despite the heavy borrowing, the 747-8 does not share the Dreamliner's defining structural feature: the 787 builds its fuselage from carbon fiber composites, whereas the 747-8 remains an aluminum airframe, so it cannot offer the Dreamliner's lower cabin altitude and higher humidity. The final aircraft left the production line in early 2023 after 155 had been built, and the freighters, which account for the majority of deliveries, seem likely to remain in service for decades. The 747-8 also previews how Boeing is likely to modernise mature designs: the 777X pairs a new composite wing with new engines on a fuselage descended from the 777, a pattern that mirrors the 747-8's selective borrowing.

zh.title: 波音747-8身上的787血統：發動機、機翼與客艙如何借鏡夢幻客機
zh.summary: 波音2005年11月推出747-8時，定位為換裝787技術的747-400升級版：GEnx發動機、後掠翼尖、線傳飛控與夢幻客機風格客艙都源自787計畫，但鋁合金機身與貼近747-400的駕駛艙則刻意保留；最後一架747-8於2023年初下線，共生產155架。
body: 波音2005年11月推出747-8，定位為加長、換翼、換發的747-400升級版，大量借用787夢幻客機的技術。787計畫僅早一年啟動，其輕量複合材料、高效發動機與電子化管理系統，正好在老牌巨無霸需要升級時提供了現成方案。波音沒有為有限市場全新研發四發客機，而是把787的創新嫁接到熟悉的機身上，既控制開發成本，也保留老客戶熟悉的操作特性；借用大膽與否，取決於性能、認證、成本與機師熟悉度之間的取捨。

借用最直接的是發動機。747-8搭載四具GE GEnx-2B67發動機，是787用GEnx的縮小衍生型，單具推力66,500磅（30,164公斤），風扇直徑105英寸（267公分），採複合材料扇葉。由於747仍用傳統氣動架構，發動機需加裝引氣接口；短艙後緣的鋸齒狀結構則借自787的降噪設計。對照表顯示，787的GEnx-1B長184.7英寸、風扇111.1英寸、最大起飛推力76,100磅，2B型則為169.7英寸、104.7英寸與66,500磅；1B型壓縮器4級、低壓渦輪7級，2B型各少一級。機翼也全面更新：全新翼型搭配後掠翼尖，翼展增至約224英尺（68.27公尺），高於747-400的約211英尺（64.31公尺），支撐更高的最大起飛重量；後掠翼尖的做法源自777與787，透過減少翼尖渦流阻力提升巡航效率，波音也將747-8較747-400更高的巡航速度歸功於機翼、翼尖與發動機的綜合效果。

客艙與飛控同樣借鏡787，但有所保留。747-8採用787的線傳飛控理念，駕駛艙布局與操控手感卻刻意貼近747-400，讓原機組容易轉換機型；客艙則導入夢幻客機風格的弧形天花板、LED全艙照明與加大窗戶，上層甲板的窄螺旋梯改為寬闊弧形梯，機身加長18英尺4英寸（5.5公尺），典型三艙布局可載467名乘客。747-8沒有跟進787最關鍵的特徵：787機身以碳纖維複合材料打造，747-8仍是鋁合金機身，因此無法提供787的低客艙高度與高濕度。最後一架747-8於2023年初下線，共生產155架，貨機占多數交付量，未來可望繼續服役數十年；747-8的模式也預示波音未來如何升級成熟機型，777X同樣在777衍生機身上搭配全新複合材料機翼與新發動機。

facts.claim: Boeing launched the 747-8 in November 2005 as a stretched, re-winged and re-engined update of the 747-400 using technology borrowed from the 787 Dreamliner.
The 747-8 uses four General Electric GEnx-2B67 engines, each generating 66,500 pounds (30,164 kg) of thrust with a 105-inch (267 cm) composite fan.
The GEnx-1B for the 787 has a fan diameter of 111.1 inches and maximum takeoff thrust of 76,100 lbs, against 104.7 inches and 66,500 lbs for the GEnx-2B.
The 747-8's larger wing extends the span to roughly 224 feet (68.27 meters), compared with about 211 feet (64.31 meters) on the 747-400.
The 18-foot-4-inch (5.5 meter) fuselage stretch lets Boeing quote a typical three-class capacity of 467 passengers.
The final aircraft left the production line in early 2023 after 155 had been built.
Unlike the 787's carbon fiber composite fuselage, the 747-8 remains an aluminum airframe.
